calculation.description: Fade the day's close-to-open directional move, normalized by the full intraday high-low range. Higher values favor assets whose close-to-open move was relatively weak or negative, consistent with short-horizon cross-asset reversal. Signal is available after the completed daily bar only.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.069609, 617 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.053665, 410 dates), and 2025-2027 YTD (+0.022397, 491 dates), with weakening but no sign reversal in the recent regime. Small cross-section uncertainty is mitigated by 1,518 date observations; average N is 11.6.
validation.admission: Passes benchmark absolute daily IC >= 0.0070 and absolute daily ICIR >= 0.0840. Library correlation is provenance only and requires deterministic audit.
